title: Changes in the Anterior Segment After Cycloplegia With a Biometer Using Swept-Source Optical Coherence Tomography
author: Tomoaki Higashiyama
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.i5bcg2n

steps.title: Instill Cyclopentolate Drops
steps.instruction: Instill Cyclopentolate hydrochloride 1% ophthalmic solution (Cyplegin 1%, Santen Pharmaceutical, Osaka, Japan) onto the eye three times, spacing each instillation by 10 minutes.

steps.title: Measure Lens Thickness and Refraction
steps.instruction: Exactly 60 minutes after the final cyclopentolate instillation, determine lens thickness using the biometer and obtain refraction using an autorefractometer.

substeps.instruction: Measure lens thickness with the swept‑source OCT biometer.
